description: Deterministic hash of a learner.inference.recorded payload without changing the frozen YAYA_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 number domain.
source: The exact closed learner.inference.recorded payload object.

requirements: score_delta and confidence are finite JSON numbers with at most six decimal places
score_delta_ppm = exact_decimal(score_delta) * 1000000 and is an integer in [-300000, 300000]
confidence_ppm = exact_decimal(confidence) * 1000000 and is an integer in [0, 1000000]

projection: Copy every source field except inference_sha256, score_delta and confidence; add score_delta_ppm and confidence_ppm with the transformed integer values. Preserve null run_id and every nested actor and evidence field exactly.
invariants: Object member order never affects the digest because YAYA_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 sorts keys.
Array order remains significant; evidence_refs is therefore sorted by evidence_id before persistence.
No implementation may round a number that has more than six decimal places.
